tagline: 禄来中画幅相机，1936 年发布
description: 禄来于1936年推出的中画幅相机。配备Zeiss Triotar 1:3.5 f=7,5cm。快门速度1 to 1/300 sec., T and B.。

specs.英文简介:
The Rolleicord II is a model in a long line of Rolleicords which started in 1933
and ended in 1977 and were produced by Franke & Heidecke and later on by Rollei-Werke in Braunschweig, Germany.
